figures.ask_en: What is on each axis here, and what are the three traces?
figures.ask_zh: 這張圖兩軸各是什麼？三條線分別是什麼？
figures.a_en: Optical density against silica added, over 41 doses. The three traces are our Pro photometer, our Slim photometer and the benchtop BioDrop reference. The Pro is about 5.3 times more sensitive than the Slim. At the top of the ladder the Pro departs 11.5 percent from its own low-range straight line and the Slim departs 2.9 percent, so the Slim is the more linear of the two over the whole range.
figures.a_zh: 橫軸是加入的二氧化矽量，縱軸是光密度，一共 41 個加料點。三條線分別是我們的 Pro 光度計、我們的 Slim 光度計，以及桌上型 BioDrop 參考儀。Pro 的靈敏度大約是 Slim 的 5.3 倍。在梯度最上端，Pro 偏離自己低濃度段直線 11.5%，Slim 只偏離 2.9%，所以整個量程看下來 Slim 反而比較線性。
kw_zh: Pro 是 Slim 的 5.3 倍
figures.q_en: What does this silica ladder show about the two photometer builds?
figures.q_zh: 這張二氧化矽梯度圖說明了兩台光度計的什麼事？
opt_en: The Pro is about 5.3 times more sensitive, but the Slim stays straighter at the top of the range
Both builds read exactly the same values once the blank is subtracted
The Slim saturates before the Pro does
Neither build tracks the BioDrop at any concentration
opt_zh: Pro 的靈敏度約為 5.3 倍，但在量程上端 Slim 比較不偏離直線
扣掉空白之後兩台讀出來的數值完全相同
Slim 比 Pro 更早飽和
兩台在任何濃度下都跟不上 BioDrop
figures.trap_en: Equating sensitivity with accuracy. More sensitive is not more linear, and this figure separates the two.
figures.trap_zh: 把靈敏度當成準確度。比較靈敏不等於比較線性，這張圖剛好把兩件事分開。

figures.ask_en: What is the challenge in this figure, and how much did the gates buy you?
figures.ask_zh: 這張圖做的是什麼挑戰測試？那兩道關卡幫你們改善了多少？
figures.a_en: An eleven-minute bubble challenge on the Pro. The amber trace is the raw reading, swinging between 0.74 and 3.19 against a true level of 3.175. The green trace, through both rejection gates, stays flat on the truth. Ungated the worst reading is 2.44 OD away from the truth; gated the worst is 0.016. On the Slim the same change goes from 0.28 to 0.003.
figures.a_zh: 這是在 Pro 上做的十一分鐘氣泡挑戰。琥珀色是原始讀值，在 0.74 到 3.19 之間亂跳，真值是 3.175。綠色那條是通過兩道剔除關卡之後的結果，穩穩貼在真值上。沒有關卡時最差的讀值離真值 2.44 OD；有關卡時最差只差 0.016。在 Slim 上同樣的改善是從 0.28 降到 0.003。
figures.q_en: What is the amber trace in this figure?
figures.q_zh: 這張圖裡琥珀色那條線是什麼？
opt_en: The raw reading during a bubble challenge, before the rejection gates are applied
The BioDrop reference measured in parallel
The reference channel of the photometer in sensor counts
The reading from the Slim build rather than the Pro
opt_zh: 氣泡挑戰期間的原始讀值，也就是還沒套上剔除關卡之前
同時並行量測的 BioDrop 參考值
光度計參考通道的感測器計數
來自 Slim 而非 Pro 的讀值
figures.trap_en: Claiming bubbles are 'handled' in general. This is one controlled challenge on the bench, with its own worst-case numbers; quote them.
figures.trap_zh: 籠統地說氣泡「已經處理好了」。這是實驗桌上一次受控的挑戰測試，有自己的最壞值；把數字講出來。

figures.ask_en: What is this histogram of, and what is wrong with the picture?
figures.ask_zh: 這張直方圖統計的是什麼？這張圖透露了什麼問題？
figures.a_en: Where the photometer's reference channel sat across the 434-hour run, in sensor counts from 18 to 36. Of 2671 readings, 91.5 percent fall on an exact integer count, with 1219 of them at 32. That is what a burst returning a single count value looks like, not what an average over sixteen samples looks like. In other words, the reference channel was not really averaging, which is a fault we found in our own data.
figures.a_zh: 統計的是 434 小時那次長跑中，光度計參考通道落在哪些值，橫軸是 18 到 36 的感測器計數。2671 筆讀值裡有 91.5% 剛好落在整數上，其中 1219 筆落在 32。這是「一個突發取樣只回傳同一個計數值」的樣子，不是「十六次取樣平均」該有的樣子。換句話說，參考通道其實沒有在做平均——這是我們從自己的資料裡找出來的缺陷。
figures.q_en: What does the pile-up of readings on exact integer counts tell you?
figures.q_zh: 讀值全部堆在整數計數上，代表什麼？
opt_en: The reference channel was returning single burst values, not an average over sixteen samples
The culture had stopped growing, so the reading stopped changing
The LED had failed and the sensor was reading only dark current
The data were rounded to integers when they were written to disk
opt_zh: 參考通道回傳的是單次突發值，不是十六次取樣的平均
菌液停止生長，所以讀值不再變化
LED 壞掉，感測器只讀到暗電流
資料寫入磁碟時被四捨五入成整數
figures.trap_en: Blaming rounding on output. The raw samples are stored; the shape of this histogram is about how the channel was sampled, not how it was printed.
figures.trap_zh: 推說是輸出時四捨五入。原始取樣都有存下來；這張直方圖的形狀講的是通道怎麼取樣，不是怎麼列印。

figures.ask_en: What do the shaded bands mark, and what do they prove?
figures.ask_zh: 圖上的陰影區塊標的是什麼？它們證明了什麼？
figures.a_en: Hours 77 to 101 of the 434-hour run, two panels on one time axis. The top is reported OD600 stepping up from about 0.78 to 0.94; the bottom is the reference channel stepping between 32, 32.5 and 33 counts. The shaded bands are every stretch where the reference has left 32. The reported density is higher inside every band and settles again when the reference returns, which proves the steps were an instrument artefact, not growth.
figures.a_zh: 這是 434 小時長跑中第 77 到 101 小時，兩個子圖共用同一條時間軸。上面是回報的 OD600，從大約 0.78 一階一階升到 0.94；下面是參考通道在 32、32.5、33 計數之間跳動。陰影標出的是每一段參考值離開 32 的區間。回報的濃度在每一段陰影裡都比較高，等參考值回到 32 就又降回去——這證明那些階梯是儀器假訊號，不是真的生長。
kw_en: OD steps up inside every band
kw_zh: 每段陰影裡 OD 都往上跳
figures.q_en: What is the relationship these two panels demonstrate?
figures.q_zh: 這兩個子圖展示的是什麼關係？
opt_en: Reported OD600 steps up exactly when the reference channel leaves 32 counts, so the steps are an artefact
OD600 rises whenever the pH falls, so the culture is acidifying as it grows
The flow rate drops whenever transmembrane pressure rises
The sample channel and the reference channel agree to within one count all run
opt_zh: 回報的 OD600 剛好在參考通道離開 32 計數時往上跳，所以那些階梯是假訊號
pH 下降時 OD600 就上升，表示菌液邊長邊酸化
跨膜壓差上升時流量就下降
整段實驗中樣品通道與參考通道差距都在一個計數以內
figures.trap_en: Reading the steps as real growth. The point of the figure is that they are not; this is the team catching its own instrument out.
figures.trap_zh: 把那些階梯當成真的生長。這張圖的重點正好相反：是團隊自己抓到儀器的問題。

figures.ask_en: What do the two bars represent, and what is the difference between them?
figures.ask_zh: 這兩條長條各代表什麼？它們的差別在哪裡？
figures.a_en: Each bar is a whole logged record from the same reactor and the same strain, six days apart. The solid part is what can be read as a growth curve. Run 5, without the gate, is solid for only its first 10.6 hours and hatched for the remaining 27, with three restarts. Run 6, with the gate running, is solid for 37 hours and hatched for the last 4.8, where the beam was lost and flagged. Same hardware, same organism: the difference is the software gate.
figures.a_zh: 每一條長條是一整段紀錄，來自同一台反應器、同一株菌，相隔六天。實心的部分是真的可以當成生長曲線來讀的段落。第 5 次實驗沒有開關卡，只有前 10.6 小時是實心，後面 27 小時都是斜線，中間還重開了三次。第 6 次實驗開了關卡，實心有 37 小時，只有最後 4.8 小時是斜線——那是光束失去並被標記的時候。同樣的硬體、同樣的菌：差別就在軟體關卡。
kw_zh: 同一台反應器相隔六天
figures.q_en: What makes the difference between the two bars?
figures.q_zh: 造成這兩條長條差異的原因是什麼？
opt_en: The software rejection gate: with it running, far more of the record is readable as a growth curve
A different strain of B. subtilis in each run
A change from the Pro photometer to the Slim photometer
A new hollow fiber cartridge fitted between the two runs
opt_zh: 軟體剔除關卡：開了之後，紀錄中可以當成生長曲線來讀的比例大幅提高
兩次實驗用的是不同的 B. subtilis 菌株
從 Pro 光度計換成 Slim 光度計
兩次實驗之間換了新的中空纖維濾芯
figures.trap_en: Claiming the gate improved the biology. It improved how much of the record is usable, nothing more.
figures.trap_zh: 宣稱關卡讓生物表現變好。它只是讓紀錄中可用的比例變高，僅此而已。

figures.ask_en: What kind of curve is this, and why does it fall rather than rise?
figures.ask_zh: 這是什麼樣的曲線？它為什麼是往下掉而不是往上升？
figures.a_en: The ELISA standard curve for His-tagged protein: six concentrations from 0.093 to 3 micrograms per millilitre, in duplicate, plotted as percent B over B-zero. It falls because this is a competitive ELISA: more analyte means less binding of the labelled competitor. The plotted trend is logarithmic, y equals minus 17.984 ln x plus 52.996, R squared 0.9967, but the concentrations in our tables are read off a constrained four-parameter logistic fit, not off this line.
figures.a_zh: 這是 His 標籤蛋白的 ELISA 標準曲線：六個濃度，從 0.093 到 3 微克/毫升，各做兩重複，縱軸是 %B/B0。它往下掉是因為這是競爭型 ELISA：待測物越多，帶標記的競爭者結合得越少。圖上畫的趨勢線是對數式，y = −17.984 ln(x) + 52.996，R² = 0.9967；但我們表格裡的濃度是用受限四參數邏輯斯迴歸讀出來的，不是用這條線。
figures.q_en: Why does this standard curve go down as concentration goes up?
figures.q_zh: 為什麼這條標準曲線隨著濃度升高反而往下掉？
opt_en: It is a competitive ELISA, so more analyte means less signal from the labelled competitor
The protein degrades at the higher standard concentrations
The plate reader saturates above 1 microgram per millilitre
The axis is inverted so that the fit can be drawn as a straight line
opt_zh: 這是競爭型 ELISA，待測物越多，帶標記競爭者產生的訊號就越少
蛋白在較高濃度的標準品中會降解
盤讀機在 1 微克/毫升以上就飽和
縱軸是反過來畫的，為了讓擬合看起來是直線
figures.trap_en: Quoting the logarithmic equation as the one that produced our numbers. It is drawn on the figure; the tables come from the four-parameter logistic fit.
figures.trap_zh: 把圖上那條對數方程式說成我們數字的來源。那只是畫在圖上的趨勢線；表格裡的數字來自四參數邏輯斯擬合。

figures.ask_en: What is being tracked here, and where is the peak?
figures.ask_zh: 這張圖追蹤的是什麼？高峰在哪裡？
figures.a_en: A DNPH time course of the ACC deaminase activity that B. subtilis WB800 carrying AcdS 2.1 secreted into the shell side of the bioreactor, in nanomoles of alpha-ketobutyrate per millilitre per hour. It is near zero at 1, 6 and 12 hours, peaks at 18 hours at about 31, then falls to about 19 at 24 hours and about 11 at 30. The peak at 18 hours is what sets our harvest timing.
figures.a_zh: 這是 DNPH 時間序列，測的是帶 AcdS 2.1 的 B. subtilis WB800 分泌到反應器殼側的 ACC 去胺酶活性，單位是奈莫耳 α-酮丁酸/毫升/小時。1、6、12 小時都接近零，18 小時衝到最高約 31，24 小時掉到約 19，30 小時約 11。18 小時這個高峰就是我們收料時機的依據。
figures.q_en: What does this time course show?
figures.q_zh: 這張時間序列顯示了什麼？
opt_en: Secreted ACC deaminase activity on the shell side peaking at about 18 hours
Optical density of the culture rising through a 72-hour run
The pH of the culture bottle falling as the culture grows
ELISA concentration of BoPep4 under green and red light
opt_zh: 殼側分泌的 ACC 去胺酶活性，大約在 18 小時達到高峰
菌液在 72 小時實驗中光密度的上升
菌液瓶 pH 隨著生長而下降
綠光與紅光下 BoPep4 的 ELISA 濃度
figures.trap_en: Confusing activity with concentration. DNPH measures what the enzyme does; ELISA measures how much of it is there. The two time courses are not the same figure.
figures.trap_zh: 把活性跟濃度搞混。DNPH 測的是酵素做了什麼，ELISA 測的是有多少酵素。這兩條時間序列不是同一張圖。

figures.ask_en: What technique is this, and what does panel C show?
figures.ask_zh: 這是什麼技術？C 圖顯示了什麼？
figures.a_en: An anti-His Western blot of ACC deaminase from B. subtilis, with a mouse monoclonal anti-His antibody. Panel A is culture supernatant from the constitutive Pveg construct with one band at about 37 kilodaltons. Panel B is purification by imidazole elution at 25, 10, 150 and 250 millimolar. Panel C is a bioreactor run sampled from 14 to 44 hours, as lumen-side cell lysate, lumen-side medium and shell-side medium: the lysate lanes are dark and the two medium groups are nearly blank, which is the honest limit on how much we can see in the medium by blot.
figures.a_zh: 這是 B. subtilis 產生的 ACC 去胺酶的抗 His Western blot，用小鼠單株抗 His 抗體偵測。A 圖是組成型 Pveg 構築的培養上清液，在約 37 kDa 有一條帶。B 圖是以咪唑沖提純化，濃度依序是 25、10、150、250 mM。C 圖是一次反應器實驗從 14 到 44 小時的取樣，分成管腔側細胞裂解液、管腔側培養基、殼側培養基三組：裂解液那幾道顏色很深，兩組培養基幾乎空白——這就是 blot 在培養基上能看到多少的誠實上限。
kw_zh: 培養基那幾道幾乎空白
figures.q_en: In panel C, which lanes carry the dark bands?
figures.q_zh: 在 C 圖裡，哪一組的帶是深的？
opt_en: The lumen-side cell lysate lanes; the lumen and shell medium lanes are nearly blank
The shell-side medium lanes, which is how secretion was proven
Every lane equally, because the loading control worked
Only the 44-hour lanes, across all three sample types
opt_zh: 管腔側細胞裂解液那幾道；管腔側與殼側培養基幾乎空白
殼側培養基那幾道，分泌就是這樣被證明的
每一道都一樣深，因為載量對照做得好
只有 44 小時那幾道，三種樣品都是
figures.trap_en: Using this blot as proof of secretion into the shell. It is not; the shell-side evidence is the ELISA and DNPH on the permeate, not this blot.
figures.trap_zh: 拿這張 blot 當作分泌到殼側的證據。它不是；殼側的證據是透過液的 ELISA 與 DNPH，不是這張 blot。

figures.ask_en: What are the two traces, and what is the ratio between them?
figures.ask_zh: 這兩條線各是什麼？它們之間的比值是多少？
figures.a_en: Pressure drop against flow on 16 August. The grey trace is the loop with a plain tube in place of the module, the background; the blue trace is the same loop with the hollow fiber module fitted. With the module in, the drop is roughly 1.8 to 1.9 times the tubing-only value across dials 12 to 24, reaching 1.87 times at dial 24. Subtracting the background is how we get the membrane's own pressure drop.
figures.a_zh: 這是 8 月 16 日的壓降對流量圖。灰色是把模組換成一段直管時的迴路，也就是背景；藍色是同一個迴路裝上中空纖維模組之後。裝上模組之後，在轉盤 12 到 24 的範圍內壓降大約是只有管路時的 1.8 到 1.9 倍，在轉盤 24 時達到 1.87 倍。把背景扣掉，才得到薄膜自己的壓降。
figures.q_en: What is the grey trace in this figure?
figures.q_zh: 這張圖裡灰色那條線是什麼？
opt_en: The same loop with a plain tube in place of the membrane module: the background to subtract
The theoretical Hagen-Poiseuille prediction for the fibers
A second series taken on a different day with the same module
The permeate flow on the shell side rather than the lumen flow
opt_zh: 同一個迴路但把薄膜模組換成直管：要扣掉的背景
纖維的 Hagen-Poiseuille 理論預測
同一個模組在不同日期量的第二組數據
殼側透過液的流量，而非管腔流量
figures.trap_en: Quoting the measured drop as the membrane's. Most of it is plumbing until you subtract the background.
figures.trap_zh: 把量到的壓降直接說成薄膜的壓降。在扣掉背景之前，大部分其實是管路造成的。

figures.ask_en: What software is this, what is being measured, and what sets the scale?
figures.ask_zh: 這是什麼軟體？在量什麼？比例尺怎麼定的？
figures.a_en: ImageJ, with twelve numbered traces along the primary roots of one agar plate, drawn below a baseline. The root lengths come out of these traces. The scale is set first with Set Scale against the 150 millimetre ruler photographed in every frame, then each root is traced with the segmented line tool and saved in the ROI manager so the measurement can be re-opened and checked.
figures.a_zh: 這是 ImageJ，在一盤洋菜培養皿上沿著十二條主根畫了十二條編號軌跡，基準線畫在上方。根長就是從這些軌跡量出來的。比例尺是先用 Set Scale 對著每張照片裡都入鏡的 150 公釐直尺設定，再用分段線工具描每一條根，並存進 ROI 管理員，之後可以重新打開檢查。
figures.q_en: What sets the scale for these root-length measurements?
figures.q_zh: 這些根長測量的比例尺是靠什麼定出來的？
opt_en: A 150 mm ruler photographed in every frame, entered through ImageJ's Set Scale dialog
The known diameter of the petri dish, assumed to be standard
The camera's reported focal length and working distance
The spacing of the seed template holes, which is fixed by the 3D print
opt_zh: 每張照片裡都入鏡的 150 公釐直尺，透過 ImageJ 的 Set Scale 對話框輸入
培養皿已知的直徑，假設它是標準規格
相機回報的焦距與工作距離
種子模板孔距，因為那是 3D 列印固定的
figures.trap_en: Saying the dish diameter sets it. The ruler is in the frame on purpose, so the scale travels with the photograph.
figures.trap_zh: 說是用培養皿直徑定的。直尺是刻意放進畫面的，比例尺才會跟著照片一起走。
